name: Dang Vu
line: Matt · fullstack engineer · TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node · Hanoi
paragraphs: I started in 2022 as a developer trainee at FPT Software. Six months of learning that most of software is other people. That autumn I joined Bravebits and spent three years on PageFly, a page builder merchants use for their storefronts.

The work I remember is the slow work. Making a page load faster is unglamorous: you measure, you find the thing nobody wants to touch, you touch it carefully. It made me suspicious of clever code and fond of code that is obvious a year later. I also built tooling that turned designs into editable pages, and learned more from its failure cases than its demos.

Since November 2025 I have been at sending.ac, building the product from the ground up with a small team of genuinely good engineers. It is the first time I have worked at real startup pace: short sprints, decisions made in a day, the whole surface up for grabs. I take features from nothing to working and I am the one paged when they break, which has quietly changed how I write everything.
In my free time I play with Rust, mostly by sending small patches to tensorzero and nextest.
